computer shell: interactive login shell

Usage: computer [-c NAME] shell

Opens an interactive bash login shell on the computer in your terminal (raw
mode, resizes follow your window). Exit with `exit` or Ctrl-D. For scripted
use, prefer exec.

Prints: the terminal session

Examples:
  computer -c alice shell

Where: on the chosen remote (-c NAME); inside a computer without a remote it acts locally
Exit codes: the shell's exit code; 1 when it couldn't start
